answer: Each epoch a random verifier cohort, at least ten epochs old and having sat out the last draw, re-checks 2% of previous attestations, each posting a saffron bond slashed on a false pass. A sybil farm can never pre-position a trusted ring: every draw voids the last, and a clone born today waits ten epochs on the knoll before earning a seat. The summit of a rotation means ten cohorts of live, bonded agents kept in parallel; cost scales with swarm age, and neither bond nor liveness history transfers to a fresh alias.
